_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Guanacaste, Costa Rica. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: El Vaquero & Eat at Joe's (Witch's Rock Surf Camp)
deals.deal: Sunset happy hour daily 4-7 PM: discounted cocktails, long drinks and craft pints
deals.details: Daily happy hour at the beachfront El Vaquero bar and Eat at Joe's. The page does not list prices.
deals.location: Tamarindo · Beachfront at Witch's Rock Surf Camp

deals.name: Tabú Tamarindo
deals.details: Daily beachfront happy hour with two-for-one selected drinks.

deals.name: The Wave Bar
deals.deal: 50% off selected alcoholic drinks, Mon-Fri 3-5 PM
deals.details: Weekday happy hour at the sports bar in Centro Comercial Pacifico.
deals.location: Playas del Coco · Centro Comercial Pacifico

deals.name: The Wave Bar
deals.details: Tuesday special on beer towers. The page does not list hours for the special.
deals.location: Playas del Coco · Centro Comercial Pacifico

deals.name: Zi Lounge
deals.details: Daily happy hour with two-for-one drinks made with national liquors, plus discounted cocktails and local beers.
deals.location: Playas del Coco · 151 Playas del Coco

deals.name: ATV Tours Tamarindo (Action Tours CR)
deals.deal: Save $10 per person when you book direct on the website
deals.details: The operator states a $10 per person saving for ATV and UTV tours booked through its own website. Credit card payments carry a 20% processing fee per the operator.
deals.location: Tamarindo · In front of Banco Nacional, Plaza Avenida

deals.name: Coyote Sportfishing
deals.deal: 10% off your next trip when you book directly
deals.details: The charter company offers 10% off a return trip for guests who book with it directly. Boats depart from Tamarindo Beach.

deals.name: Iguana Surf
deals.deal: 50% off board rentals with any booked surf lesson
deals.details: Guests who book a lesson get half off board rentals for the rest of their stay. Group lessons are $60 per person plus tax.
deals.location: Tamarindo · On the beach below Iguana Surf Boutique Hotel

deals.name: Pacific Coast Dive Center
deals.deal: 50% off the second child under 12 on family bookings made online
deals.details: Family promotion on the snorkel tour ($95 plus 13% VAT) and Discover Scuba Diving; requires 2 adults and 1 child and booking through the center's online system.

deals.name: Tamarindo Surf & Tours
deals.details: Multi-lesson surf packages priced below the $80 private lesson rate, plus tax; the 5-lesson pack includes a photo session on the final lesson.
